text:
sam: Quick follow-up to the RFC about removing the legacy API shim. Plan sketch: 1) introduce a feature flag + shim passthrough for cohorts 2) run a canary for 72h 3) monitor errors/latency and expand cohorts 4) deprecate shim and clean code paths.

maria: +1. Can we avoid a big DB migration? Need to keep tenant routing compatibility. Suggest adding a compatibility layer in the router service instead of touching schemas.

cheng: Router change LGTM. Concern: our integration tests for multi-tenant routing are flaky; we need a deterministic harness before full rollout.

olivia: I can own the tests. Can we define the metrics to watch? My list: 1) 5xx rate per route 2) p99 latency on hotpath 3) prefix cache miss rate 4) error-budget burn.

sam: Good list. Also add shim-fallback-rate and model-variant-fallback counts. We should automate rollback when 5xx spikes > 0.5% sustained for 10m.

henry: Deployment plan suggestion: cohorts as feature-flagged tenant groups: 5% -> 20% -> 50% -> 100% over 48h windows. Each step gated by metrics.

maria: To keep churn small, use the existing feature-flags service. Flag names and shape: 

```yaml
flags:
  shim_sunset:
    state: "cohort"
  shim_cohorts: "cohort-a,cohort-b,cohort-c"
  shim_auto_rollback_threshold: "0.5%"
```

sam: @olivia can you add the dashboards and alerts? @cheng please spike the deterministic harness. I'll open the rollout PR with a canary checklist.

deploy-bot: deploy started: canary/shim-sunset/sha:abc123

cheng: Started the harness spike, found one race in tenant config reload. Patching now, will push a small test-only change.

olivia: Dashboards done. Alert names: shim_sunset_5xx, shim_sunset_p99, shim_sunset_cache_miss. Linked to oncall.

sam: Thanks. Timeline: aim for a first cohort next Tue, patch + tests by EOD Fri. If anything blocks, shout here. :thumbsup:
